title: Palak Paneer
description: Blanched spinach blended to a bright green purée, built into a garlic-ginger masala, and finished with pan-seared cubes of paneer and a swirl of cream.

image.alt: Palak paneer curry with spinach and cubes of cheese, served with flatbread

ingredients: 2 tbsp heavy cream, plus more to serve
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 90 seconds, then plunge into ice water. Drain well and blend to a smooth purée with a splash of water.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the paneer cubes until golden on a couple of sides, 3–4 minutes. Set aside.
In the same pan, heat the remaining oil and the cumin seeds until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook 6–7 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic, ginger, and green chili, cooking 1 minute more.
Add the tomatoes, coriander, and turmeric. Cook 5–6 minutes, mashing the tomatoes, until the mixture thickens and the oil separates.
Stir in the spinach purée and simmer 4–5 minutes. Add the seared paneer and garam masala, and simmer 2 minutes to heat through.
Stir in the cream, season with salt, and serve with an extra swirl of cream on top.
note: Shock the spinach in ice water right after blanching — it's what keeps the purée bright green instead of drab olive.
